title: Code and analysis for: Does Early Entropy Warn of Token-Budget Exhaustion in Chain-of-Thought Decoding?

creators.name: Pastushenko, Maksym
creators.affiliation: National Technical University of Ukraine "Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute"

description: Decode loop, per-step signal computation and analysis scripts for the preprint Does Early Entropy Warn of Token-Budget Exhaustion in Chain-of-Thought Decoding? The decode loop reads the raw logits before any temperature or truncation is applied and stores, for every step, entropy and four other statistics at a fixed reference temperature, entropy at seven temperatures, and the top-32 logits. The analysis scripts reproduce every number and figure of the preprint from the released trajectories in about five minutes on a CPU (bash reproduce.sh), and compare the output with the reference tables in expected/.
